about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Chicken and Mushroom Pie with Puff Pastry Lid
recipes.summary: Creamy thyme chicken and mushrooms under a golden puff pastry lid.
steps: Brown the chicken in the butter for 6 minutes, until golden, then add the onion and mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock, cream, thyme and salt and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick. Cool slightly.
Heat the oven to 200C. Pour the filling into a pie dish and cover with the pastry, pressing the edges and cutting a vent.
Brush with beaten egg and bake for 30 minutes, until puffed and golden and the filling reaches 75C.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken until the thickest part reaches 75°C and the juices run clear. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Serve with peas.

recipes.title: Sausage and Bean Casserole (Slow Cooker)
recipes.summary: Pork sausages and beans slowly cooked in a smoky tomato gravy.
steps: Brown the sausages in a pan for 5 minutes, until coloured all over.
Put everything in the slow cooker with the sausages.
Cook on low for 5 hours, until the sausages are cooked through at 75C and the sauce is thick.
Remove the bay and serve with mash or crusty bread.
notes: Food safety: cook mince and sausages until they reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Prawns and Cheesy Polenta (Southern Shrimp and Grits)
recipes.summary: Spicy bacon prawns over creamy polenta.
steps: Whisk the polenta into the boiling salted water and cook on low for 20 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy. Stir in the cheddar and butter.
Fry the bacon in a pan for 5 minutes, until crisp.
Add the garlic, Cajun seasoning and prawns and cook for 3 minutes, until the prawns turn pink and opaque.
Add the stock and lemon juice and simmer until glossy.
Spoon over the polenta and scatter with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook fish until it turns opaque and flakes easily with a fork. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Seafood must be cooked until opaque.

recipes.title: Baked Crab Cakes with Lemon and Herb Mayonnaise
recipes.summary: Sweet crab and herbs, baked until golden rather than fried.
steps: Mix the crab, egg, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, mustard, 1/2 cup panko, spring onion, parsley and Cajun seasoning.
Shape into 8 cakes and chill for 15 minutes, until firm.
Toss the remaining panko with the butter, press onto the cakes, and bake at 220C for 18 minutes, until golden and hot through.
Stir the lemon juice and dill into the remaining mayonnaise and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook fish until it turns opaque and flakes easily with a fork. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Use fresh or pasteurised crab and keep chilled.

recipes.title: Tamale Pie (Beef and Polenta Bake)
recipes.summary: Spiced beef and corn filling under a golden polenta crust.
steps: Brown the mince and onion for 8 minutes, until no pink remains, add the garlic, seasoning, tomatoes, corn and beans and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Whisk the polenta into the boiling salted water and cook for 10 minutes, until thick, stirring in half the cheese.
Spread the filling in a baking dish, spoon the polenta over and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
notes: Food safety: cook mince and sausages until they reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Freezes well before baking.

recipes.title: Al Pastor-Style Pork and Pineapple Tray Bake
recipes.summary: Chilli-spiced pork shoulder with caramelised pineapple, for tacos or rice bowls.
steps: Toss the pork with chilli, cumin, oregano, garlic, juice, vinegar and salt.
Spread the pork, onion and pineapple on a lined tray, heat the oven to 230C and roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Check the pork reaches 70C inside, then chop roughly.
Warm the tortillas and fill with pork, pineapple, coriander and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook pork until it reaches at least 70°C in the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Marinate overnight for more flavour.

recipes.title: Pescado Zarandeado-Style Grilled Fish
recipes.summary: Whole-style fish fillets brushed with a chilli-citrus paste and grilled until flaky.
steps: Mix the chilli, garlic, soy sauce, juice of the orange and lime, mayonnaise and oil into a paste.
Brush the fish all over, then grill on medium-high for 4 minutes each side, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Serve with warm tortillas, coriander and onion.
notes: Food safety: cook fish until it turns opaque and flakes easily with a fork. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Marinate 30 minutes in the fridge if you have time.

recipes.title: Brazilian Chicken Strogonoff
recipes.summary: Creamy tomato chicken with mushrooms, served with rice and corn.
steps: Cook the chicken in the butter for 6 minutes, until golden, and set aside.
Cook the onion, garlic and mushrooms for 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the paste, sauce and mustard, then add the chicken and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 10 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75C.
Add the cream and corn and warm gently until hot, then serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken until the thickest part reaches 75°C and the juices run clear. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Do not boil after adding the cream.

recipes.title: Xinxim de Galinha (Bahian Chicken with Peanuts and Coconut)
recipes.summary: Chicken in a creamy peanut and coconut sauce with chilli and herbs.
steps: Blend the peanuts with the stock until smooth.
Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, then cook the onion, garlic, ginger, chilli and paste for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the peanut mixture and coconut milk, then simmer for 30 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75C and the sauce is thick.
Finish with coriander and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken until the thickest part reaches 75°C and the juices run clear. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Hangi-Style Slow Roast Lamb with Kumara and Pumpkin
recipes.summary: New Zealand-inspired oven-steamed lamb and root vegetables with a savoury stuffing.
steps: Rub the lamb with oil and salt. Heat the oven to 150C.
Wrap the lamb tightly in foil with the stock, set on a tray and cook for 3 hours, until falling apart at 85C.
Add the vegetables to a dish and cook beside the lamb for the last hour, until soft.
Mix the stuffing with the water and bake for 30 minutes, until set. Rest the lamb 15 minutes and pull apart.
notes: Food safety: cook lamb until tender and at least 70°C throughout. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
A tray version of the earth-oven classic.

recipes.title: Lentil Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Mash
recipes.summary: A vegan pie of lentils, mushrooms and carrots under creamy sweet potato.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms and garlic in the oil for 10 minutes, until soft.
Add the lentils, stock, paste, soy sauce and thyme and simmer for 30 minutes, until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick. Stir in the peas.
Boil the sweet potato for 15 minutes, until soft, then mash with the olive oil.
Spoon the lentils into a dish, top with mash and bake at 200C for 20 minutes, until golden.
notes: Vegan and freezer friendly.

recipes.title: Mushroom Bourguignon
recipes.summary: Red wine braised mushrooms and carrots, rich and glossy, over creamy polenta.
steps: Sear the mushrooms in the oil in batches for 6 minutes, until browned, and set aside.
Cook the onion, carrot and garlic for 6 minutes, stir in the paste, then add the wine, stock, thyme and bay and simmer for 20 minutes, until reduced.
Return the mushrooms, stir in the cornflour mixed with a little water and simmer for 10 minutes, until glossy.
Whisk the polenta into the boiling salted water and cook for 10 minutes, until thick, then serve with the mushrooms.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Vegan Cassoulet with Herbed Breadcrumbs
recipes.summary: A slow-baked white bean stew with a crisp garlicky crumb crust.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the beans, tomatoes, stock, herbs and bay and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Tip into a baking dish, toss the breadcrumbs with the parsley and oil, and scatter over.
Bake at 200C for 30 minutes, until the crumb is golden and the beans bubble.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Eggplant Rollatini with Ricotta and Tomato
recipes.summary: Roasted eggplant rolled around herbed ricotta and baked in tomato sauce.
steps: Brush the eggplant slices with oil and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, until soft and golden.
Mix the ricotta, egg, basil and garlic.
Spread the passata in a baking dish, spoon ricotta onto each slice, roll up and set seam down.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and breadcrumbs and bake at 190C for 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Frittata di Spaghetti
recipes.summary: A crisp-edged Italian omelette made with leftover spaghetti, peas and mozzarella.
steps: Cook the spaghetti until al dente, drain and cool a little.
Beat the eggs with the mozzarella, peas, parsley and salt, then fold in the pasta.
Heat the oil and garlic in a 26 cm non-stick pan, pour in the mixture and cook on low for 8 minutes, until the base is golden and the edges set.
Flip with a plate, cook for 5 minutes, until firm, and slice into wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Uses up leftover spaghetti.

recipes.title: Cheese Boreks (Turkish Feta and Parsley Filo Rolls)
recipes.summary: Crisp filo cigars filled with salty feta and parsley.
steps: Mix the feta, parsley, egg and yoghurt.
Cut each filo sheet in half, brush with oil, add a line of filling and roll into cigars, tucking in the ends.
Place on a tray, brush with oil and scatter with sesame seeds.
Bake at 190C for 20 minutes, until deep golden and crisp.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Leek and Potato Pie with Cheddar
recipes.summary: A creamy leek, potato and cheddar pie under puff pastry.
steps: Boil the potato for 8 minutes, until nearly tender, and drain.
Cook the leeks in the butter for 8 minutes, until soft, stir in the flour, then the milk, crème fraîche and mustard and simmer 5 minutes, until thick.
Fold in the potato and cheddar and cool slightly.
Fill a pie dish, cover with pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes, until golden.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Kale and Potato Frittata with Feta
recipes.summary: Golden baked frittata with soft potato, kale and salty feta.
steps: Cook the potato in the oil for 12 minutes, until tender and golden. Add the onion and kale and cook until wilted.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pour over, scattering with feta.
Cook on low for 5 minutes until the base is set, then bake at 190C for 12 minutes, until puffed and set.
Rest for 5 minutes and slice.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Potato Rosti with Fried Egg and Chive Sour Cream
recipes.summary: Crisp golden grated potato cakes topped with a fried egg.
steps: Squeeze the potato and onion dry in a clean cloth and mix with the salt.
Heat half the butter in a pan, press in the mixture in 4 patties and cook on medium for 6 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Fry the eggs in the remaining butter until the whites are set.
Top each rosti with an egg and a spoonful of sour cream mixed with chives.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower Shawarma Wraps
recipes.summary: Spice-roasted cauliflower with garlic tahini, pickles and parsley in flatbread.
steps: Toss the cauliflower with the oil, spices and salt and roast at 220C for 30 minutes, until charred and tender.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and 1/4 cup water until smooth.
Warm the flatbread, then fill with cauliflower, tahini, parsley and pickled turnip.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Kofte (Turkish Lentil Patties)
recipes.summary: Spiced red lentil and bulgur patties wrapped in lettuce with lemon.
steps: Simmer the lentils in the water for 12 minutes, until soft. Stir in the bulgur, cover and stand for 15 minutes, until fluffy.
Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, stir in the paste, cumin and chilli, then mix into the lentils with spring onion, parsley and salt.
Knead until it holds together, then shape into small ovals.
Serve wrapped in lettuce leaves with lemon.
notes: Vegan.
